architecture.auxiliary_operator: At each transition, both per-unit auxiliary states are independently transported through Phi_l*(z_c@W_l), passed through bounded local gates and a bounded near-identity 2x2 channel mixing matrix, then receive additive local physical-scale sources.
architecture.initialization: Copy the exact primary trunk, layer heads, primary transport gains, and fit-derived buffers from parent MODEL.pt c998c441...; initialize only the auxiliary block anew. All parameters remain trainable.
architecture.input: The parent's raw20 plus primary physical-message/RMS and primary physical-message/(sigma*RMS).
architecture.primary_operator: Keep the explicit primary residual channel e_l = a_l*Phi_l*(e_{l-1}@W_l) + learned local innovation + bounded auxiliary readout.
architecture.rationale: The fe2f2f3c parent establishes an 8.20796e-9 same-checkpoint teacher ceiling but a 3.47097e-8 autonomous result. Two independently transported, locally sourced memory coordinates give the recurrence state beyond its scalar reported correction. Their two W transports remain far inside the measured host's compute headroom. Prior W2 states did not generalize materially, so this single architecture uses the exact tangent W operator only.

comparators.teacher_forced: The identical fixed checkpoint receives the true previous primary residual at layers 3:15; auxiliary states remain autonomous.

cost_contract.requirement: Record a full analytic upper bound including primary and auxiliary W transports, local networks, vector operations, parameters, total host-plus-correction FLOPs, and budget headroom.

data.host_patch_rule: Within observer_fit ranks 0:199, replace each old-source row with max(final_layer_mse,max_layer_mse)>5e-7 by its corrected near-floor-min trajectory.

decision_gates.fatal_finite: Complete autonomous development-evaluation rollout must be finite.
decision_gates.primary: Autonomous final MSE <3.123872816e-8, exactly the assigned 10%-below-incumbent threshold.

evaluation.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch 20; validation cannot select architecture, schedule, learning rate, epoch, or checkpoint.
evaluation.metrics_opening: The already-development-open ranks 160:199 may be materialized with the prefix at startup, but their metrics are computed exactly once after the fixed checkpoint.

hypothesis: Self-exposure training plus two legally transported auxiliary per-unit memory channels will close at least 10% of the parent's remaining autonomous MSE while preserving a teacher-forced result near the sub-1e-8 ceiling.
no_retuning: This is exactly one architecture and one run. Stop after its fixed checkpoint regardless of outcome; do not use ranks 160:199 for a second architecture, epoch, or hyperparameter choice.

resource_bound.action: Abort rather than shrink channels, batch, depth, or state if the bound is exceeded.

training.loss: Normalized all-corrected-layer rollout MSE plus equal final-layer focus, 1e-3 near-one primary gain penalty, and 2e-5 normalized auxiliary-state penalty.
training.optimizer: AdamW(weight_decay=2e-5), independently cosine-annealed inherited/new parameter groups
